title: Why I Added Human Approval Instead of Letting AI Do Everything
content:
I gave my AI agent one job: qualify leads
and draft replies.
Then I blocked it from sending anything.
Here is why I added HUMAN APPROVAL instead
of letting the AI do everything.
This is the LinkedIn reality-check slot
for Wednesday.
I am building a lead-qualification agent
in public this week.
The tempting demo is full autopilot.
The useful product is a draft plus a human gate.
Stay till the end for the 4 rules I use
before I unlock send.
Without a gate, 3 things go wrong fast.
One: the model invents a budget, a
discount, or a timeline that was never
written.
Two: it replies to spam like it is a buyer
and burns your sender reputation.
Three: it sounds confident when it is
wrong, and a customer trusts the wrong
number.
Speed is not the win if trust breaks.
Serious teams already treat irreversible
steps as workflows, not free chat.
AWS made Step Functions available as AI
agent tools through Bedrock AgentCore
Gateway,
so ordered steps like approvals stay ordered.
Your sales DM or CRM agent should copy that idea.
DRAFT IS REVERSIBLE. SEND IS NOT.
Here are my 4 rules before I unlock send.
Rule 1: written hot, warm, cold criteria.
Rule 2: the agent may only read fields
that exist. It may NEVER INVENT.
Rule 3: every outbound needs a human tap
for at least the first 2 weeks.
Rule 4: a KILL SWITCH that disables send
tools in one place.
If any rule is missing, the agent stays in
draft-only mode.
Imagine a small agency with 40 inbound
leads a day.
The agent scores them and fills an approve queue.
A founder spends 12 minutes clearing the
queue instead of 2 hours hunting the
inbox.
That is the business case for human-in-the-loop.
Not fear. Throughput with judgment.
Career angle, because this is also how I
talk about AI Solutions Engineer roles.
Hiring managers do not only ask if you can
call an API.
They ask if you know where the model must stop.
If you can design the approval gate, the
log, and the kill switch,
you look like someone who can ship to a
real business.
Here's my take.
FULL AUTONOMY IS A DEMO.
Human approval is a product.
I will unlock send only after the drafts
stay clean for 2 weeks of logged reviews.
Until then, the agent works for me. I do
not work for its mistakes.
Comment 'AI' on Instagram and I'll send
you the free checklist, or grab the link
in the LinkedIn post.
Follow for your daily AI update.
